slightlyretarded69: The new rifleman gave his name as Florian "Shadow" Slightlyreta. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
The first hundred were recognised, and Florian "Shadow" Slightlyreta was among them. He wrote the news on the back of an unfinished letter.
Florian "Shadow" Slightlyreta raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-F14. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Isidor Glc of the Concord (@leo.glc).

Florian "Shadow" Slightlyreta no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. Verdel Ridge is lost. Florian "Shadow" Slightlyreta heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
